articles.title: Carhartt CEO: Our value comes from workwear brand's 'authenticity'
articles.mainIdea: Carhartt CEO: Our value comes from workwear brand's 'authenticity'
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Carhartt CEO: Our value comes from workwear brand's 'authenticity'. Workwear brand Carhartt is teaming up with American automaker Ford (F) to shine a headlight on the growing skilled labor shortage within the US manufacturing industry. Carhartt CEO Linda Hubbard speaks with Market Catalysts Anchor Julie Hyman and Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi about the brand's Ford partnership and the value of functional workwear for tradesmen. Also catch Linda Hubbard's comments on how skilled labor opportunities are largely going "unnoticed" in the US. Be sure to watch Yahoo Finance's most recent interview with Ford CEO Jim Farley. To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts. Related tickers mentioned: F.
